The TSV status column is unchanged: git diff b78fdde1..cddadba3 -- docs/fantasy-world-scene-blueprints.tsv is empty and the docs diff holds only the two mill shots. The scene id mill and its path did not change: the scenes/maps/mill.ts diff is one line (line 125 gains yaw: -65 on the watermill place), the file still exports places(), src/scene/main.ts line 215 loads it by slug name through the import.meta.glob at line 18, and no second source for mill exists. bash check-rework.sh exits 0 with 39 checks, PASS=39, FAIL=0. Two Nits: the additive model_id key in rerate-mill.json, and the durability risk that the yaw fix lives in the generated file while the generator stays unchanged (F2, already disclosed in green-p3.log lines 73-74).
